title: AdvancementScreenPlus
description: A Fabric mod for 1.20.1 that enhances the advancement screen.
body:
# Advancement Screen Plus
 
A Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that enhances the advancement screen.
 
## Features
 
- **Custom Line Renderer** - Replaces the vanilla advancement connection lines with a renderer.
- **Flashing Lines** - Highlights completed advancement connections with a configurable flash effect.
- **Fruchterman-Reingold Layout** - An alternative graph-based layout algorithm that produces a more dynamic arrangement of advancements compared to the vanilla layout.
- **Data-Driven Advancements** - Supports custom advancements defined through datapacks.
- **Better Advancements Compatibility** - Works alongside the [Better Advancements](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-advancements) mod.

## Configuration
 
All features are configurable through the mod’s config file **or directly in game via [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)**
 
- **Use Vanilla Lines** — Toggle the mod's custom line renderer on or off.
- **Draw Arrows** — Show arrows on connection lines pointing to the next advancement.
- **Flashing Lines** — Enable or disable the flash effect on completed connections.
- **Flash Rate** — How fast the lines flash.
- **Layout Algorithm** — Switch between `Vanilla` and `Fruchterman-Reingold` layouts.
